EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Your photo was declined for the following reason:
Insert reason here
Please submit a new photo following the guidelines below. After your new photo is approved, you will need to resubmit the Mail Request form . https://cfo.asu.edu/campus-id-card-request-form or the Pickup Request Form https://cfo.asu.edu/webform/basic-sun-card-office-pick-form
You will need to attach a valid, current photo ID as proof of identity. Acceptable forms of ID are: US drivers license, state issued ID card, US passport or US Visa.
Uploaded photos must meet the following criteria:
Upload your photo NOW https://webapp4.asu.edu/cardservices/
Regards, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
